technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with multiple overbought conditions and long-term bearish structure create high reversal risk; lacks triggered entry signal and volume confirmation for swing trade.

fundamental.summary: WBD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 33 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for WBD; mixed congressional activity (one senior Republican buy offset by junior Democrat sale), neutral market sentiment, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 33 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational WBD.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (SMA 20/50), bullish ADX, supertrend, and Ichimoku cloud breakout provide short-term momentum confirmation with price near support (12.0667) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI (84.99) and stochastic (85.49) overbought conditions, absence of triggered entry signal, below 200-EMA/SMA, weak volume (0.72 ratio), zero fundamental support, and macro crisis (VIX 194.7, inverted yield curve, earnings in 33 days) create unacceptable reversal and event risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and supertrend provide short-term momentum, but extreme RSI/stochastic overbought (84.99/85.49) with no triggered entry signal and zero fundamental support create unacceptable risk-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought conditions combined with VIX crisis (194.7), inverted yield curve, and earnings in 33 days create high probability of sharp reversal or gap-down event.
